universal_ridiculous.template: Christopher Walken riding a giant version of [OBJECT_FROM_QUOTE] through a thunderstorm, detailed matte painting
Christopher Walken as a Renaissance oil painting, holding [OBJECT_FROM_QUOTE], gold-leaf frame, dramatic chiaroscuro
Claymation Christopher Walken in a 90s music-video set, interacting with [OBJECT_FROM_QUOTE], stop-motion textures
Christopher Walken bobblehead on a car dashboard, [OBJECT_FROM_QUOTE] visible through the windshield

prompt_assembly_rules.per_entry: image_prompt.archetype (key) + image_prompt.scene (quote-specific detail) → builder concatenates archetype.desc + ', ' + scene into full_prompt. For universal_ridiculous, builder fills bracketed slots from image_prompt.slots.
prompt_assembly_rules.style_suffix: cinematic, 35mm film grain, high detail — applied by builder unless image_prompt.style_override is set
prompt_assembly_rules.score_gating: only populate image_prompt for meme_score >= 4. Score-3 entries may optionally carry an archetype-only hint.

gemini_global_settings.likeness_anchor: A man resembling Christopher Walken: silver slicked-back hair, deep-set pale eyes, gaunt angular face, late-60s or early-70s age, distinctive classic features, sharply attentive expression unless otherwise noted
gemini_global_settings.negative_prompt: deformed face, extra limbs, extra fingers, malformed hands, watermark, text overlay, subject rendered as a young man, subject rendered as a child, distorted features, uncanny valley, low quality
gemini_global_settings.technical_suffix: Portrait 3:4 aspect ratio, highly detailed, professional cinematography, sharp focus, clear subject framing

mood_style_routing.notes: Applied by the prompt builder based on entry tags. If multiple moods match, priority is: funny > uplifting > tender > defiant > dark > ominous > (default).

styles.uplifting: Warm golden palette, bright natural sunlight, subject appears joyful or elated, soft focus, optimistic mood, uplifted expression
styles.tender: Soft warm lighting, gentle expression, intimate framing, pastel palette, quiet emotional warmth
styles.funny: Bright saturated palette, playful absurd staging, comic energy, subject has amused or wry expression, light-hearted mood
styles.defiant: Strong directional lighting, high contrast, bold composition, subject determined and confident, powerful stance
styles.dark: Moody chiaroscuro, desaturated cold palette, deep shadows, tension, restrained emotion
styles.ominous: Noir styling, near-monochrome, heavy shadows, unsettling atmosphere, implied threat
styles.default: Cinematic 35mm film grain, dramatic lighting, balanced mood, classic character framing
